biggest_catch: Your money sits in limbo for up to 72 hours after delivery while the buyer decides whether to dispute - and none of it exists until someone actually buys your listing.
catches: SidelineSwap charges seller fees that reduce proceeds; shipping is on you unless built into the price.
The buyer can dispute within the 72-hour window, which can delay or reverse your payout.
Nothing sells until a buyer buys - price depends on demand for your specific gear.
Payout timing depends on the buyer approving quickly; slow buyers mean the full 72-hour wait.
Resale catch-all: value varies by condition and demand; quotes and market prices can change; fees or shipping can reduce your actual proceeds.

steps: List your sports gear with photos and a price
Buyer purchases; you ship the item
Buyer approves on receipt, or funds auto-release 72 hours after delivery
Cash out available funds to your bank
timing: Funds available after buyer approval or automatically 72 hours after delivery.
who_pays: Your buyer - SidelineSwap is a sports-gear marketplace, not the buyer. Your payout comes from the buyer's payment after they approve the item.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+, in the US, and own the item. Sports gear categories only.
work_available: This is a marketplace: nothing sells until a buyer buys your gear. Slow-moving items sit; pricing against recently sold listings is what gets things moving.
what_gets_accepted: Any sports gear within the category rules can be listed - but the buyer can dispute within the 72-hour window after delivery, which can delay or reverse your payout.
costs_and_unpaid_time: SidelineSwap charges seller fees that reduce proceeds, and shipping is on you unless built into the price. Your unpaid time is listing with photos, shipping, and messaging buyers - quick buyer approval starts your payout clock sooner.
when_cash_arrives: Real cash - funds become available after the buyer approves the item, or automatically 72 hours after delivery. You can then cash out available funds to your bank.
